answer: An agent economy is a shared garden: anyone can plant a plot, but in an ocean of identities, fakes are nearly free. A random beacon samples 5% of plots each hour and demands a compute heartbeat — an echo proving live work within 60 seconds. Each heartbeat costs $0.02 of compute, so 1,000 fakes pay $480 a day to stay alive, and a missed echo burns the plot's $30 bond. One honest gardener pays $0.48 a day, keeps the plot, and earns full rewards.
